# 1 Clement Chapter 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 2 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_002_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 2

**2:1** All of you were given a deep and rich peace, with an insatiable desire for doing good, and a full outpouring of the Holy Spirit was upon all of you.

**2:2** You were full of holy intention, and with genuine eagerness and a devout readiness you stretched out your hands to the Almighty God, beseeching him to be merciful if at any time you had inadvertently committed any offense.

**2:3** Day and night you were earnest on behalf of the entire brotherhood, that the sum of his elect might be preserved with compassion and a clear conscience.

**2:4** You were sincere and guileless and free of resentment toward one another.

**2:5** All sedition and all schism were abominable to you. You grieved over the transgressions of your neighbors; you considered their shortcomings as your own.

**2:6** You did not repent of any act of kindness, but were ready for every good work.

**2:7** Adorned with a thoroughly virtuous and reverend manner of life, you performed everything in his fear. The commandments and the ordinances of the Lord were inscribed upon the tablets of your hearts.

---

*LOGOS formal equivalence translation from Codex Alexandrinus.*
